operation.description:
MUTATING operation. Verify target and authorized intent; reconcile outcome before retry. Updates a record in a workflow-type entity. This is a v2 native-entity endpoint served from the `/v2/api/entity` base and authenticated with a Bearer token. Both `PUT` and `POST` to this path are accepted.

The `workflow_id` path segment selects the workflow type (entity key `le_workflow-type-entity-{workflow_id}`) and `record_id` identifies the record. The request body is a **flat object** whose keys are the workflow type's fields and **must include `id` matching `record_id`**. Custom fields are supplied under the `le_workflow-type-entity-{workflow_id}_custom_data` object (include its existing row `id` to update in place).

**Required fields are defined by the selected workflow type** and enforced server-side; a missing required field returns `400` with an `errors` map (note: unlike create, which returns `422`). On success the `message` is localized to the workflow type's name, e.g. `"<name> Updated Successfully"`.

parameters.name: workflow_id
parameters.description: The id of the workflow type. Combined with the resource prefix this forms the entity key `le_workflow-type-entity-{workflow_id}`.

id.description: The id of the record to update. Must match the `record_id` in the URL.

number.description: Auto-numbering fieldset. Provide `number.code` (the numbering-scheme code) only if changing it. Required only when the workflow type requires it.

budget.description: Budget as a Currency fieldset (`number`, `currency`). Required per the workflow type's configuration.

le_workflow-type-entity-{{workflow_id}}_.description: Per-workflow custom fields to update. Include the existing custom-data row `id` to update it in place; the available fields are defined by the workflow type.

200.description: Record updated. `message` is localized to the workflow type's name; `id` is the record id.

400.description: The update could not be completed. Cases: record not found → `{"message":"Record not found"}`; validation failure → `{"message":"Entity not saved","errors":{...}}`; save error → `{"message":"Entity not saved","error":"<detail>"}`; or a permission denial → `{"message":"<reason>"}`.

errors.description: Present on validation failure: map of field name to validation messages (dot notation for nested fieldsets).

401.description: The access token is missing or invalid.

404.description: The record could not be loaded for update.
